2Masthead 'Department…' lockup lineMajorSCW-GLOBAL-002

3Font family not rendering as Noto SansMajorSCW-GLOBAL-003
Typography
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
All text is set in Noto Sans (the DBIM standard typeface).
BUILD — LIVE
Many build text elements render in a fallback face — Noto Sans is requested in CSS but isn't actually loading, so headings/body fall back to a system font.
FIX
Ensure the Noto Sans webfont actually loads on the build (font files + @font-face) so text doesn't fall back to a system face. Recurs site-wide.
